legend-great-st-bernard-pass-road.slogan: Great St Bernard Pass Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-great-st-bernard-pass-road.story: curated scenic road. historic pilgrimage route, high alpine. 47 km from Martigny-Ville to Aosta, about 51 min of riding. On the way it passes Orsières and Saint-Rhémy. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Great St Bernard Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Great St Bernard Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 10 km this is Great St Bernard Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
